scope: Five specific factual docstring corrections in two owned figure widgets; not complete files/package review
code_evidence: FigureQueue._cache_pixmap compares len(_ram) with _ram_cap, moves entries to LRU end, evicts oldest; constructor default RAM_CAP=100.
figure_text_items returns every non-None collected item without identity de-duplication.
CellMontageView._cap uses MAX_OBJECTS=2000 from spacr/cell_montage.py; load uses request.cap or MAX_OBJECTS; GUI cap supports user override.

changes.before:
temporary PNG. The newest 100 full-resolution ``QPixmap`` objects remain in
memory; older entries reload their PNG on demand, while thumbnails stay in
memory. Clearing the queue or destroying its owner removes the temporary
directory.
changes.after:
temporary PNG. Full-resolution ``QPixmap`` objects use a least-recently-used
cache, limited by the ``ram_cap`` entry count (100 by default). Evicted entries
reload their PNG on demand, while thumbnails stay in memory. Clearing the
queue or destroying its owner removes the temporary directory.

changes.before: :returns: Text objects in traversal order, with duplicate objects removed.
changes.after:
:returns: Text objects in traversal order, omitting missing entries.
        Repeated references are retained.

changes.before:
:param ram_cap: how many bytes of figures the gallery may hold. Older
        figures are dropped to stay under it, which is what "RAM-bounded"
        above means -- a pipeline emitting hundreds of figures must not grow
        without limit.
changes.after:
:param ram_cap: maximum number of full-resolution pixmaps in the RAM
        cache, 100 by default. Least-recently-used entries are evicted;
        their PNG files remain available for reloading. This is an entry
        count, not a byte limit or a limit on all process memory.

changes.before:
:param ram_cap: how many bytes of full-resolution pixmaps to keep in
            memory; older ones are evicted by least-recent use.
changes.after:
:param ram_cap: maximum number of full-resolution pixmaps to cache
            in memory, 100 by default; entries are evicted by least-recent use.

changes.before:
GUI-thread completion handler updates widgets. Converting at most 300 crops to
``QPixmap`` remains on the GUI thread because QPixmap is not transferable
across threads; the recorded 224-pixel thumbnail conversion takes about
21 milliseconds for 300 crops.
changes.after:
GUI-thread completion handler updates widgets. The montage cap limits the
selected objects and defaults to :data:`spacr.cell_montage.MAX_OBJECTS`
(2,000). Converting image arrays to ``QPixmap`` occurs on the GUI thread;
image loading and crop selection occur in the worker.

checks: AST identical excluding docstrings; diffcheck. No behavior change, test run, benchmark or global semantic completion claimed.
